title: CRA-SME Toolkit: a risk-driven, evidence-based research toolkit for EU Cyber Resilience Act implementation in SMEs
description:
Research toolkit for implementing and evaluating the EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847) in small and medium-sized enterprises.

Contents: a 46-obligation CRA requirements catalogue (CSV) with references, application dates and evidence types; a risk and evidence workbook (xlsx, v1.0 and corrected v1.1); the crasme Python package (ordinal and Monte Carlo risk models, inter-rater agreement statistics, SBOM and vulnerability-scanner accuracy metrics, Article 14 reporting clocks and tabletop scoring, a traceability JSON Schema with a score-independent release gate, an evidence provenance manifest); a SHA-pinned GitHub Actions evidence workflow; protocols, pre-registration template and data-collection templates for eight experiments (E1-E8); six executed Jupyter notebooks; a pilot SBOM generator benchmark (real tool output, 3 fixtures); a review of toolkit v1.0; and a comparison with existing solutions and related work.

Data status: only experiments/e1_sbom_benchmark/pilot-results/ contains real tool output. All other example and notebook data are synthetic and labelled as such.

Limits: research instruments only; not legal advice, not an official CRA assessment and not a conformity assessment. Risk scores are not CRA criteria.

Licensing: code under Apache-2.0; documentation, templates, catalogue, workbooks and notebook text under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSES/ and README).
notes: Version 1.1.0 (research edition). Synthetic data is labelled; see README for the licensing split and REVIEW-v1.0-findings.md for open items requiring legal review.
